state.phase: Planning only; no implementation authorized. Advisory choice, not acceptance.
human_outcomes: Replace handwritten mechanics with qualified libraries where simpler
Preserve Can byte/error/source-identity contracts and portable finite module resolution
Keep each contract independently releasable; no global all-library barrier
source_facts: Existing collectSpecifiers iterates from/reexport group, literal dynamic import() group, side-effect group; order within group is source scan, not global lexical order. Relative imports use posix normalize+join and exact known-set. Allowed producers @canlang/stdlib and @canlang/ui. Raw regex captures escaped literal source text and may match comments/nonimports. buildDeployBundle public API is synchronous; es-module-lexer3.0.3 minimal/js is a synchronous asm candidate with no Wasm init. Lexer recognizes more actual imports and provides decoded specifier plus original UTF16 spans. Current CJS/Bun loadability checks are separate and stay unchanged.

Raw source-map lookup decodes every call and returns map.sources[src] verbatim, ignores sourceRoot, omits invalid optional name, stops on unmapped1field, and selects last equal generated column before first overshoot. It does not sort. Existing VLQ uses JS32bit shift; signed-zero VLQ B yields -0; no explicit overflow/negative/sort guards. sourcemap-codec1.6.0 sorts unsorted lines and maps B to -2147483648; trace-mapping0.3.31 GLB selects first duplicate and resolves sourceRoot/path. Thus straightforward substitution changes observed behavior.

Current malformed character/truncation/field-count errors are public sourcemap-prefixed bytes; library docs do not qualify actual target semantics. No new decoder should be casually hand-rolled just to force a library win. Native preparation remains HUMAN HOLD.
constraints: Node-side lexer/edit/composition tooling separate from Worker lookup shipped closure
Broader semantic correction requires explicit decision and positive/negative oracle witnesses; existing compatibility gates remain open.
uncertainty: More-recognized import forms may affect real bundled vendor code and need target-host qualification
No product build/library install/behavior benchmark has run in this planning step.

import_policy.instructions: Recommend one bounded import-contract direction for this planning-only release, weighing true JS literal semantics, old error order, generated module policy and added complexity equally across the supplied options.

criteria.decoded_compat: Select lexical imports and decoded JS literal identity for resolution, preserving original group ordering/error envelopes for old real-import forms. Explicitly record corrections (remove false matches, newly recognized forms, escaped literal semantics); deterministic refusal of computed imports at finite-map admission and syntax parse fault before module policy. Require real fixture/caller/delivered-host qualification before adoption.
criteria.raw_compat: Use lexical records but preserve raw-spelling resolution/rejection for previously recognized imports; reject newly recognized/escaped/computed forms outside current generated-source contract. Minimize immediate behavior changes but can reject valid code or retain source-profile complexity.
criteria.split_profiles: Keep current regex semantics as explicit legacy profile and add opt-in lexer decoded policy with separate routing/qualification. Preserves old behavior while adding supported correctness, but keeps duplicate mechanisms and permanent profile maintenance.

raw_map_policy.instructions: Recommend one planning treatment of noncanonical map compatibility, weighing current public observations, qualified producer intent, delivery closure and hand-maintained duplicate parsing across the supplied alternatives.

criteria.retain_contract_candidate_gate: Freeze exact current raw behavior as oracle; pin codec/trace candidates but hold D03 replacement until a bounded qualification proves a small adapter preserves required domain or an explicit narrower-profile/semantic change is justified. Keep current decoder now, do not claim library adoption or force large duplicate decoder. Import/N releases remain independent.
criteria.canonical_profile: Adopt codec/trace for canonical sorted bounded maps, explicitly route noncanonical maps to retained current decoder before lookup; preserve public behavior with disjoint qualified profiles, but maintain two mechanisms and a trustworthy admission classifier.
criteria.correct_now: Change to canonical library decoding/lookup with strict noncanonical refusal, explicit new error/rejection contract. Simpler implementation but changes accepted raw-map behavior and may silently alter diagnostics unless all consumers migrate.
